mapper.sql: SELECT I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NM, I.ITEM_TY, I.CL_CODE, CL.CODE_NM AS CL_CODE_NM, I.UNIT_CODE, UN.CODE_NM AS UNIT_CODE_NM , I.MIN_QTY, I.USE_AT, I.STOCK_QTY, I.RESERVED_QTY , IFNULL(U.STORED_QTY, 0) AS STORED_QTY , CASE WHEN I.ITEM_TY = 'QTY' THEN I.STOCK_QTY ELSE IFNULL(U.STORED_QTY, 0) - I.RESERVED_QTY END AS AVAIL_QTY , (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASSET_STOCK_HIST H WHERE H.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASSET_REQ_LINE L WHERE L.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ASSET_UNIT A WHERE A.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE)) AS HAS_HIST FROM ASSET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN (SELECT ITEM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS STORED_QTY FROM ASSET_UNIT WHERE STTUS = 'STORED' GROUP BY ITEM_CODE) U ON U.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE CL ON CL.CODE_ID = 'AST001' AND CL.CODE = I.CL_CODE LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE UN ON UN.CODE_ID = 'AST002' AND UN.CODE = I.UNIT_CODE
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_STOCK_HIST WHERE ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode} FOR SHARE) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_REQ_LINE WHERE ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_UNIT WHERE ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode} FOR SHARE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_ITEM (ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NM, ITEM_TY, CL_CODE, UNIT_CODE, MIN_QTY, USE_AT, STOCK_QTY, RESERVED_QTY, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) VALUES (#{vo.itemCode}, #{vo.itemNm}, #{vo.itemTy}, #{vo.clCode}, #{vo.unitCode}, #{vo.minQty}, 'Y', 0, 0, #{actorId}, SYSDATE())
